out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: general tso chicken in a tray on the steam table
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CFM LABELED FOOD WITH TIME.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: EHS observed what appeared to be pest droppings on the floor next to upright roasting oven and 3 comp sink area.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. E-MAIL EHS PEST CONTROL INVOICE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting board on the refrigerated prep unit is heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: exterior of all rice cookers/ warmers, interior and exterior of all refrigeration units (WIC floor especially), white cart with spices.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floors under all equipment and walls throughout are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lockers, Provided
violations.observation: Personal foods and other personal items are found throughout the kitchen without any dedicated space
violations.corrective_action: Provide proper storage facilities for employees' personal belongings to prevent contamination of food, food equipment, and food contact surfaces.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in the warewashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: undercounter fridge- sweet and sour chicken (51°F), egg roll (50°F), wonton (51°F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. DISCARDED ALL FOODS. UNIT THERMOSTAT LOWERED.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a warewashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS INFORMED CFM WHERE HANDS MUST BE WASHED.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: EHS observed employee wash equipment and put on shelf without sanitizing.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. EHS ASSISTED STAFF WITH SETTING UP 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 6 bags of whole duck in the prep sink at 71°F. CFM stated ducks were left in sink overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. DISCARDED.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: 6 bags of whole duck in the prep sink to thaw last night started off in running water, however, CFM forgot about duck in the sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. ALL DUCK DISCARDED.
